evals.prompt: I need a quick competitor analysis for the top 3 AI translation startups (specifically targeting real-time voice translation). Tell me what their names are, their websites, and how their pricing structure works.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report identifying three real-time voice translation startups, including their names, URLs, and pricing structure.
expectations: The output is a markdown file with an Executive Summary and Detailed Findings
The report identifies exactly three distinct real-time voice translation startups
Each identified startup has a website URL listed
The report describes the pricing structure for each of the three startups
Every competitor fact or claim is backed by a clickable source citation link

evals.prompt: Can you find the most recent research papers (2025/2026) discussing 'LLM agent architectures for code generation'? I want to understand what the state-of-the-art frameworks are, specifically any that utilize multi-agent validation, and their key performance benefits.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report summarizing recent papers on multi-agent code generation architectures with citations and performance benefits.
expectations: The output is a markdown report with an Executive Summary, Detailed Findings, and Sources Consulted
The report summarizes at least two frameworks or research papers from 2025 or 2026
The report specifically addresses multi-agent validation architectures
Key performance benefits of the frameworks are explicitly outlined
Each summarized paper or framework has a clickable source citation link

evals.prompt: Search for the latest news on OpenAI's advanced model developments from the last 30 days. Give me a summary of what has been announced or rumored, with specific dates and source links.
evals.expected_output: A markdown report outlining recent news on OpenAI's advanced models within the last 30 days, citing sources and dates.
expectations: The output is a markdown report with an Executive Summary and Detailed Findings
The report covers news or rumors specifically from the last 30 days
Specific dates of announcements or rumors are explicitly mentioned
Clickable markdown links are provided for the cited news sources
